fight.said: The cane comes down and finishes the rat clean — but the blow is still traveling when the bank beside you tears open, and something far bigger surges out of the nest, jaws wide, with the dog that's been shadowing you since the crossing already snarling in at your side to meet it.
fight.name: the Rat Mother

note: A dog has been trotting at her heel since the crossing — it is hers now, or near enough. The nest in the roadside bank opens and the Rat Mother comes out of it, huge and hostile, and she will not flee. Declare the fight: the dog fights alongside her with 12 health, 1–3 damage, dc 12, bonus 2. The Rat Mother has 20 health, 2–4 damage, dc 12, bonus 2, and an ability that spawns a Rat (5 health, 1–2 damage, dc 10, bonus 1) and then leaves her not stirring for 2 rounds. athletics, dc 12 to hit her, their_dc 11, flee_dc 10.
